senses.definition: A variation of the Heligoland trap, consisting of linked funnels terminating in a small chamber.
Any atom which has a single valence electron in a shell well outside any other electrons in the aton; approximates the hydrogen atom.
A universal scaling factor for all spectroscopic transitions.
A formula used in atomic physics to describe the wavelengths of spectral lines of many chemical elements.
A molecule, especially one consisting of two atoms of the same element, that has a permanent dipole because one of the atoms is in a very high excited state.
Any of those electronically excited states of an atom or molecule with energies that follow the Rydberg formula as they converge on an ionic state with an ionization energy.
Ericameria obovata, a species of flowering shrub found in North America.
Synonym of Ritz's combination principle.
A bread made partly or entirely with rye flour, which may be wholemeal (wholegrain) flour or not.
A village in the town of Rye, Westchester County, New York.
A rye groat that is cut, cooked and rolled into a flake, used as a breakfast cereal.
Flour that has been made or prepared from rye.
A locality in the Hilltops council area, south eastern New South Wales, Australia.
Caraway seed, used whole as a flavoring in the best-known type of rye bread, and often mistakenly assumed to be the rye itself.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see rye, seed.
An evil creature of German folklore lurking in the rye-fields.
A home rule-class city in Kenton County, Kentucky, United States.

The paradoxical situation whereby, if one accepts the cognitivist theory that every action is preceded by a thought, each thought must also be preceded by another thought, and so thinking could apparently never begin.
Nasogastric tube.
A village and civil parish (served by the group Parish Council of Yetminster and Ryme Intrinseca) in Dorset, England (OS grid ref ST5810).
A civil parish in Selby district, North Yorkshire, England.
A conjecture within holography that posits a quantitative relationship between the entanglement entropy of a conformal field theory and the geometry of an associated anti-de Sitter spacetime.
The Ryukyu Islands state from 1429 to 1879.
